# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

First real iteration (parent = seed). Reward 0.538 = 49/91 pass. Reward is HARD restriction:
a task counts only if ALL 3 hidden test-case instances match answer_position (adapter
lines 64–66 + score(): the agent's FINAL code is text-substituted `1_<id>_input`→`2_/3_`
and RE-RUN on two more input files with the same layout but different data). This mechanism
is invisible to the agent and drives the biggest failure cluster.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Non-generalizing / hardcoded to instance-1 | 51262, 50755, 55258, 250-20, 53957, 267-18, 58890, 32975, 48588, 30930, 49782 (signature `[1,0,0]`/`[1,1,0]` = passes instance 1, fails re-run) | Code overfits the previewed data: pastes literals, copies a "desired/answer" sheet, fixes row ranges/column maps to instance-1 extents; agent doesn't know its code is re-run on hidden data | KNOWLEDGE | Add explicit replay/generalization rule (prompt.md) |
| 2 | Wrong value type / casing / str-coercion | 585-41, 50486, 48983 | Right computation, wrong graded artifact: numbers coerced to strings via `str()`; label casing "Chep" vs sheet's "CHEP"; None vs expected empty/0 | KNOWLEDGE / OUTPUT-CONTRACT | Add type/format-fidelity rule (prompt.md) |
| 3 | No verification before finishing | most `[0,0,0]` tasks; template literally said "once that file exists, you are done" | Agent stops at "file written", never reads answer_position back to catch empty/wrong-type/hardcoded cells | STRUCTURE | Replace done-line with a verify-before-finish step (task_template.md) |
| 4 | Bespoke algorithm / task misinterpretation | 39946, 53305, 32468, 6698, 47699, 14207, 4225, 34-5, 347-49, 146-49, 577-40, 413-15, 398-14, 55912, 55039 | Genuinely wrong reading of an ambiguous spec (guessed month, all-S substitution, wrong grouping) | (not a clean prose gap) | SKIPPED — see below |
| 5 | Ambiguous / blank instruction | 55224 (instruction is " "), 53449 | No general rule derivable | — | SKIPPED |
| 6 | Formula recalculation infra failure | 45944 (feedback: "formula recalculation FAILED … Not a prompt defect — do not optimize against it") | LibreOffice recalc failed for this workbook | ENVIRONMENT | Handed back, not worked around |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Missing-rule / add-the-WHY (KNOWLEDGE) | prompt.md | New block "YOUR CODE IS RE-RUN ON HIDDEN DATA": compute from the input at run time, never paste/cache preview values, never copy a sample/answer sheet, derive row/col extents dynamically, base positions on headers not coincidental alignment | Yes — the 49 passing tasks already scored `[1,1,1]` on 3 varying-data instances, i.e. they ALREADY generalize; the rule only describes what they do, so their behavior can't change. Additive/BOUNDED. |
| 2 | Tighten output contract (KNOWLEDGE) | prompt.md | New block "MATCH THE EXPECTED VALUE'S TYPE AND FORMAT": write numbers as numbers (no `str()`), copy exact casing of labels that exist elsewhere, preserve neighbor cell type, empty only when intended | Yes — passing tasks already write correct types; additive clarification. BOUNDED. |
| 3 | Structural ordered step / checklist | task_template.md | Replaced "Final solution code … once that file exists, you are done" with a 3rd round: re-open output, print answer_position, confirm values present + right type + computed-not-hardcoded, else fix. Makes verification a precondition of "done" | Yes — passing tasks re-open, confirm, and stop with the same output. Verification is framed read-only ("if any check fails, fix"); a formula cell still reads back as a populated string so passing formula tasks (35747/37962/45581/49237/54675) are untouched. UNBOUNDED contract change but new behavior is correct for every task; no passing task relied on the removed line. |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the edit changes on those exact inputs)
- 51262: wrote `ws["F6"]=30; G6=20; H6=0` (instance-1 literals) → Edit A "Never type in or paste a value … it will be wrong for the hidden data" makes the agent implement the SUMIFS and compute per-input.
- 50755: `results=[25,3,25,22,60]` pasted literals → Edit A bans pasted constants; forces row2−row3 computation.
- 250-20: `src=wb['Desired outcome']; d.value=s.value` copies the sample answer sheet → Edit A "Never copy values out of an existing 'desired'/'answer' sheet — the hidden inputs will not contain that sample."
- 53957: `for data_row in range(15,26)` + fixed col map → Edit A "Do not hardcode row/column extents … derive them from the data."
- 585-41: `re.sub(...,str(cell.value))` coerced numbers to strings (only the text instance matched) → Edit B "Write numbers as numeric values, not strings … never wrap a number in str(...)."
- 50486: wrote "Chep"/"Loscam" but A2:A3 hold "CHEP" → Edit B "copy its EXACT text and casing from those existing cells."
- All `[0,0,0]` value tasks: agent never checked its own output → Edit C forces a re-open + print of answer_position before "done", catching empty/None cells (48983-style) and wrong types.
- Generalization reinforced structurally: Edit C item (c) makes the agent ask "would this code still be correct with different values and a different number of rows?" — a precondition of finishing, backing up Edit A.

## Confirmed-SAFE checks I ran
- Grepped all 49 passing traces: NONE write VBA/prose into cells; all compute values → Edits A/B don't fight any passing behavior.
- 5 passing tasks DO write Excel formula strings (35747, 37962, 45581, 49237, 54675) and pass via LibreOffice recalc. I therefore did NOT add a "never use formulas" rule (would regress them). The failing formula tasks (32023, 50526, 53023, 10281, 44264, 50682, 55039, 53062) explicitly ask for formulas too — same as the passing ones — so "asks-for-formula" is NOT a valid discriminator and their failures are wrong-logic/recalc, not prose-fixable. Left the existing "prefer literal values" line untouched.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 4 parallel read-only Explore agents, one per trajectory group, classified all 42 failing traces into the clusters above (HARDCODED / NONGENERALIZING-LOGIC / WRONG-OUTPUT-FORMAT / RANGE-MISREAD / AMBIGUOUS / OTHER-infra). Synthesis + all edits done on the main agent.
- Prior iterations: none (seed only; LEDGER/RUNMAP empty).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The replay/generalization block (Edit A) — it is the single highest-leverage fix; the `[1,0,0]`/`[1,1,0]` signature is the dominant lost-score pattern under hard-restriction scoring.
- Do NOT ban Excel formulas globally: 35747/37962/45581/49237/54675 pass BY writing formulas.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Cluster 4 (bespoke algorithm misreads, ~15 tasks): genuine task-comprehension errors on ambiguous specs; no general prose rule fixes them without leaking gold, and a wrong "clarification" risks regression. Left for a later iteration (candidate lever: worked examples for the most common sub-patterns — robust color/font detection, `data_only=True` when reading existing formula results).
- Cluster 5 (55224 blank instruction, 53449 underspecified): not derivable.
- Cluster 6 (45944): ENVIRONMENT — recalc failure, feedback says do not optimize against it. Handed back.
